current_task_admission.primary_reason: A held perturbation's stimulated outcomes are required to estimate scGen's latent shift, so the method cannot predict a wholly unseen target.

gse275483.reason: A delta may be learned only from animals carrying the same known perturbation in training; four animals make any result descriptive and cells cannot supply replication.

gse281160.reason: The latent delta for each noncoding target can only be computed after observing that target's perturbed cells, which violates the current target_locus holdout.

gse313774.reason: The released implementation expects single-cell AnnData and an observed stimulated versus control condition; bulk chip libraries are not valid single-cell inputs and have no cross-study matching perturbation identity.

held_target_leakage_contract.upstream_incident: predict_reads_ctrl_and_stim_cells_from_self.adata_and_randomly_subsamples_them; an AnnData containing evaluation outcomes would leak them_into_the_delta
